C_rfav_imani_kade.name: Captain Imani Kade
C_rfav_imani_kade.role: commanding officer of RFV Aegis Vigil
C_rfav_imani_kade.voice: calm, economical and specific; rarely raises her voice and asks what can actually be protected before promising it
C_rfav_imani_kade.visual: late-40s Black woman with deep brown skin, close-cropped natural hair touched with gray at the temples, strong cheekbones and steady dark eyes; broad-shouldered, composed Fleet captain in a practical deep-navy command uniform with Ion White structure and restrained gold rank marks

C_rfav_tomas_greer.name: Commander Tomas Greer
C_rfav_tomas_greer.role: executive officer and convoy-operations lead aboard RFV Aegis Vigil
C_rfav_tomas_greer.voice: plainspoken, skeptical and operational; turns promises into time, fuel, berths, escorts and consequences
C_rfav_tomas_greer.visual: early-40s man with light-brown skin, short dark hair graying at the sides, a square jaw and compact sturdy build; Fleet duty uniform worn without ceremonial additions, usually carrying a convoy slate

C_rfav_devika_arlen.name: Chief Engineer Devika Arlen
C_rfav_devika_arlen.role: chief engineer of RFV Aegis Vigil
C_rfav_devika_arlen.voice: fast, concrete and unsentimental; speaks in loads, margins, repair hours and what she can keep running
C_rfav_devika_arlen.visual: late-30s South Asian woman with warm brown skin, thick black hair braided close and pinned high for machinery work, rectangular protective optics and powerful forearms; dark Fleet engineering coverall with Ion White utility panels, tool loops and visible wear

C_rfav_safiya_menon.name: Dr. Safiya Menon
C_rfav_safiya_menon.role: chief medical officer and mass-casualty coordinator aboard RFV Aegis Vigil
C_rfav_safiya_menon.voice: measured, candid and humane; does not soften bad numbers but never reduces people to them
C_rfav_safiya_menon.visual: mid-40s woman with medium-brown skin, wavy dark hair cut at the jaw, tired attentive eyes and a slim build; Fleet medical coat over a practical blue-gray duty uniform with compact diagnostic gear

C_rfav_jonah_tern.name: Lieutenant Jonah Tern
C_rfav_jonah_tern.role: senior navigator and helm officer aboard RFV Aegis Vigil
C_rfav_jonah_tern.voice: quiet, exact and cautious about uncertainty; reports what the route can support rather than what command hopes it can support
C_rfav_jonah_tern.visual: early-30s white man with sandy-brown hair kept short, pale freckled skin, narrow blue-gray eyes and a lean pilot's posture; Fleet navigation uniform with tactile route controls and a worn wrist slate

C_rfav_rhea_calder.name: Chief Rhea Calder
C_rfav_rhea_calder.role: senior rescue and damage-control chief aboard RFV Aegis Vigil
C_rfav_rhea_calder.voice: direct, dry and reassuring only when she has earned the reassurance; gives short physical instructions under pressure
C_rfav_rhea_calder.visual: early-40s Latina woman with sun-brown skin, dark hair in a tight working braid, a broad expressive face and muscular build; reinforced rescue coverall with pressure seals, harness clips, gloves and a compact breaching-and-patch kit

C_admiral_colin_rhyne.name: Admiral Colin Rhyne
C_admiral_colin_rhyne.voice: Practical, protective, integration-minded; favors Verge pilots in Fleet pickets and civilian access.
C_admiral_colin_rhyne.visualAnchor: Older Fleet admiral in established deep-navy Aegis command dress, with a practical defensive bearing and restrained senior-officer presentation.

C_rfav_mira_dace.name: Mira Dace
C_rfav_mira_dace.role: Verge convoy master commanding the civilian carrier Wayfarer Nine
C_rfav_mira_dace.voice: dry, experienced and independent; accepts useful Fleet help without surrendering civilian authority
C_rfav_mira_dace.visual: early-50s East Asian woman with weathered tan skin, short iron-gray hair, narrow dark eyes and a wiry build; layered green-and-charcoal Verge work clothes under a battered civilian command jacket, with a route slate clipped at the chest

C_rfav_eli_varek.name: Eli Varek
C_rfav_eli_varek.role: captain of the disabled Verge freighter Good Measure
C_rfav_eli_varek.voice: strained but practical; reports damage plainly and resists pretending his ship can do more than it can
C_rfav_eli_varek.visual: late-30s man with olive skin, curly dark hair, a close beard and a bruised temple; worn civilian flight jacket over a pressure underlayer, one sleeve marked by sealant and coolant

C_rfav_jae_torren.name: Jae Torren
C_rfav_jae_torren.role: senior mechanic aboard Good Measure and keeper of its agricultural cold-storage systems
C_rfav_jae_torren.voice: blunt, stubborn and technically exact; cares about machinery because people depend on what it carries
C_rfav_jae_torren.visual: early-60s Black man with dark skin, close silver hair, a gray mustache and heavy mechanic's hands; patched green-gray coveralls, knee brace, insulated gloves and an old tool harness polished by use
